messages:
Ravi K: Heads-up — partners just updated availability windows for H200 and MI300. We need to re-evaluate our marketplace publish plan this week.
Evelyn M: Which dates changed? Any that force us to move the press week?
NVIDIA - Leo: H200 inventory ETA moved +10 days. We can still do a joint announce if partners accept a soft window in the copy. No NDA changes.
AMD - Ines: MI300 driver fix is incoming tomorrow; carrier shipments delayed by 5 days. Market enablement likely slides by one calendar week.
Infra - Kai: Practical constraints: we must validate new drivers against our kernel and model-optimizer. Current canary stack:
```
- base-image: rwd-ubuntu-22.04:gpu-1.7
- kernel: 6.1.44
- cudatoolkit: 12.2
- rocm: 5.7
```
Infra - Kai: If we regen kernels for Gaudi, add ~24h. We can parallelize some tests.
Marketing - Noor: We prefer one clean announce but safety-first. Can we create a fallback announcement that avoids firm ship dates?
Legal: Yes — prepare a non-dated variant. Partners must approve any product claims though. 24h turnaround requested.
Ravi K: Proposed timeline update:
- Day 0: partner sync + asset handoff
- Day 2: infra canary + validation
- Day 4: partner approval + legal signoff
- Day 6: publish (blocked until canary green)
NVIDIA - Leo: Day 0 prebrief OK. We need product perf bullets as "preliminary".
AMD - Ines: If the driver fix lands later today we can still hit Day 2, otherwise bump Day 4 by one week.
Infra - Kai: Spun up a 3-node canary for B200/Gaudi. Telemetry prefix: s3://redwood/canaries/3332109876/.
release-bot: Canary started: canary-3332109876, logs -> https://ci.internal/3332109876/logs
Infra - Kai: Early results: Gaudi kernel regen completed, no segfaults. Need perf baselines to compare.
Marketing - Noor: I'll mock the soft-window assets and a firm-dates set. Share link by EOD.
Legal: Added to review loop. Please tag us when assets are ready.
release-bot: Canary completed: status=PASS, artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood/canaries/3332109876/artifacts.tgz
Evelyn M: Good news. Any thermal or power concerns for B200?
Infra - Kai: B200 shows +3% peak vs previous profile. Within tolerance but recommend note in release notes.
Ravi K: OK — action items: Kai to post full canary metrics; Noor to circulate two asset variants; Legal to review soft copy; Ravi to run partner call tomorrow 10am PT. If any red flags, we hold publish.
NVIDIA - Leo: Will join call.
AMD - Ines: Oncall ready.
Ravi K: Thanks all — filing follow-ups and will update the press scheduler after the call. :calendar:
